gap_closure_fraction: ratio of scene-macro GAP_CLOSED / scene-macro BASE_GAP; recompute ratio within each paired bootstrap draw; zero/nonpositive BASE_GAP makes fraction undefined; descriptive, no theoretical-optimum claim

geometry_rules.COMPLEMENTARY: S3 better than each of S0,S1,S2 by stable practical gain.
geometry_rules.FREE_SPACE_DOMINANT: S1 better than S0 stable; S2 better than S0 not stable; S1 better than S2 stable.
geometry_rules.HARMFUL: S3 worse than S0 by stable practical gain in reverse.
geometry_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: All remaining patterns; do not force a dominant attribution.
geometry_rules.NO_CLEAR_GAIN: None of S1,S2,S3 has established stable gain over S0; absence of established gain is not evidence of zero effect.
geometry_rules.SURFACE_DOMINANT: S2 better than S0 stable; S1 better than S0 not stable; S2 better than S1 stable.

observability_rules.precedence: If OBS2PLUS coverage<.75 => INCONCLUSIVE. If OBS2 gap mean>=.02 and CIlo>0: low-support union coverage>=.75 and positive share>=.50 => MIXED; otherwise OBSERVED_REGION_FAILURE. Otherwise OBS2 gap CI entirely[-.02,.02] plus union coverage>=.75 plus positive share>=.75 => UNOBSERVED_REGION_DOMINANT; else INCONCLUSIVE.

recommendation_rules.geometry_aware: S3vsS0 stable gain AND S3 wrong-scene damage CIlo>0 AND S3 spatial-shuffle damage CIlo>0. Only recommend a future separate experiment, not independent qualification or authorization to train this round.
recommendation_rules.per_scene_spearman: Average per-query Spearman coefficients within role then A/B equally; if any locked role/query coefficient is null, the entire scene value is null. Retain all17 scene keys and require >=75%scene coverage for correlation-based classification.
recommendation_rules.visibility_aware: OBSERVED_REGION_FAILURE/MIXED=>inconclusive. Otherwise OBS2 gap CI entirely[-.02,.02], OBS01 and OBS2 scene coverage>=.75, conditional(S0 OBS01 minus S0 OBS2) mean>=.02 and CIlo>0 with paired coverage>=.75, and S0 per-scene visible-view-count/AbsRel Spearman mean CIhi<0 with correlation scene coverage>=.75 =>true. Otherwise inconclusive; never infer visibility useless.

region_rules.additive_contribution: C uses all17 scenes including zeros for empty regions; OBS0+OBS1+OBS2PLUS must reconstruct overall.
region_rules.conditional_bootstrap: Resample all17 scene indices; in each draw divide sum covered E by covered multiplicity; report all-empty draws undefined, never zero fill.
region_rules.conditional_mean: Scene conditional value E=C/F, with C=mean_role_query(region AbsRel sum / totalvalid) and F=mean_role_query(region pixels / totalvalid); mean E only among covered scenes, always retain all scene keys and empty counts.
region_rules.low_support_union: OBS01; require union coverage>=.75 for mixed/unobserved-dominant classification
region_rules.mask_identity: All direct variants share the same per-query region pixel counts and totalvalid.
region_rules.positive_gap_share: sum_scene,region_in_OBS0_OBS1 max(C_context-C_oracle,0) / sum_scene,region_in_OBS0_OBS1_OBS2PLUS max(C_context-C_oracle,0). Descriptive positive-contribution share, not a signed net-gap fraction.

statistics.unit: scene after query then A/B averaging
